facts.text: Anutin, Bhumjaithai leader and PM, says he is confident in coalition MPs' support ahead of a censure debate.
Anutin said there is no advance deal with the Klatham Party and joked 'sadhu' if it backs the government.
The opposition requested five days for the no-confidence debate; timing is still being discussed by whips.
